title: Random Potions
description: Spawns a random splash potion on you every 10 seconds.
body:
#  RandomPotions

**RandomPotions** is a lightweight Minecraft mod that adds a fun twist to gameplay:  
Every 10 seconds, a **random potion bottle** spawns directly on the player, containing a **random potion effect**!

---

##  Features
-  Every **10 seconds**, each player receives a new potion bottle.
-  Potions have **random effects** – both beneficial and harmful.

💬 Feedback, suggestions, or issues? Open an issue or reach out!
